title: Busy Docks
briefing: Harborline Shipping trades thinly, with a 0.6% spread. Watch the volume bars: when they jump, something important is happening.
objective: Volume shows participation. In a thin market, trade rarely and let big-volume news guide you.
debrief: Harborline drifted quietly on low volume until day 12, when a record freight contract brought a gap up on the biggest volume of the match, followed by a steady climb. Buying soon after that high-volume news caught the move; Newsy Nina reacted two days late. Because the spread was wide, players who traded only once or twice kept far more of their gains.
